from manim import *
import numpy as np


class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]

        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])

        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject


class Section1Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout(
            "Sec 1: Introduction: What is a Linear Transformation?",
            [
                'A linear transformation is a special function.',
                'It preserves vector addition: T(u+v)=T(u)+T(v).',
                'It preserves scalar multiplication: T(cv)=cT(v).',
                'The grid stays parallel and evenly spaced.',
                'Example: T(x,y) = (2x, y) stretches horizontally.',
            ],
        )

        # Colors
        CYAN = "#00FFFF"
        YELLOW = "#FFFF99"
        GRAY = "#CCCCCC"
        BLUE = "#4D9EFF"
        GREEN = "#66FF66"
        ORANGE = "#FFA500"

        # Grid origin on right side (center of A1..F6 area roughly)
        # Center of the right region
        origin_pt = np.array([3.5, -0.5, 0])
        # Scale for grid units in scene coordinates
        unit = 0.45

        def scene_pt(x, y):
            """Map math coords (x,y) to scene position. Math x to the right, math y up."""
            return origin_pt + np.array([x * unit, y * unit, 0])

        def make_grid(scale_x=1.0, scale_y=1.0, n=4):
            lines = VGroup()
            for i in range(-n, n + 1):
                # vertical line x = i (in transformed coords: x*scale_x)
                x_pos = i * scale_x
                start = scene_pt(x_pos, -n * scale_y)
                end = scene_pt(x_pos, n * scale_y)
                lines.add(Line(start, end, color=GRAY, stroke_width=1.5))
                # horizontal line y = i
                y_pos = i * scale_y
                start_h = scene_pt(-n * scale_x, y_pos)
                end_h = scene_pt(n * scale_x, y_pos)
                lines.add(Line(start_h, end_h, color=GRAY, stroke_width=1.5))
            return lines

        def make_arrow(x, y, color, stroke_width=5):
            start = scene_pt(0, 0)
            end = scene_pt(x, y)
            return Arrow(start, end, buff=0, color=color, stroke_width=stroke_width,
                         max_tip_length_to_length_ratio=0.15)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        line1 = self.lecture[0]
        formula_T = MathTex(r"T: \mathbb{R}^2 \to \mathbb{R}^2", color=YELLOW, font_size=32)
        self.place_at_grid(formula_T, "B4", scale_factor=0.9)

        grid1 = make_grid()
        self.place_in_area(grid1, "B2", "F6", scale_factor=1.0)

        vec_v = make_arrow(1, 1, BLUE)
        label_v = MathTex("v", color=BLUE, font_size=28)
        label_v.next_to(scene_pt(1, 1), RIGHT, buff=0.1)

        self.play(Write(formula_T), run_time=1)
        self.play(line1.animate.set_color(YELLOW), run_time=0.5)
        self.play(Create(grid1), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(GrowArrow(vec_v), FadeIn(label_v), run_time=1)
        self.wait(0.5)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        line2 = self.lecture[1]

        vec_u = make_arrow(1.5, -0.5, BLUE)
        label_u = MathTex("u", color=BLUE, font_size=28)
        label_u.next_to(scene_pt(1.5, -0.5), RIGHT, buff=0.1)

        # translation vector v placed at tip of u to draw parallelogram
        u_vec = np.array([1.5, -0.5, 0])
        v_vec = np.array([1, 1, 0])
        sum_vec = u_vec + v_vec
        vec_uv = make_arrow(sum_vec[0], sum_vec[1], GREEN)
        label_uv = MathTex("u+v", color=GREEN, font_size=28)
        label_uv.next_to(scene_pt(sum_vec[0], sum_vec[1]), UP, buff=0.1)

        # Parallelogram lines (dashed)
        p_start_u = scene_pt(1.5, -0.5)
        p_end_u = scene_pt(sum_vec[0], sum_vec[1])
        p_start_v = scene_pt(1, 1)
        p_end_v = scene_pt(sum_vec[0], sum_vec[1])
        para1 = DashedLine(p_start_u, p_end_u, color=GRAY, stroke_width=1.5)
        para2 = DashedLine(p_start_v, p_end_v, color=GRAY, stroke_width=1.5)

        # T(u), T(v) as orange arrows: T(x,y)=(2x,y)
        Tu_vec = np.array([3.0, -0.5, 0])
        Tv_vec = np.array([2.0, 1.0, 0])
        Tuv_vec = Tu_vec + Tv_vec

        vec_Tu = make_arrow(Tu_vec[0], Tu_vec[1], ORANGE, stroke_width=4)
        vec_Tv = make_arrow(Tv_vec[0], Tv_vec[1], ORANGE, stroke_width=4)
        vec_Tuv = make_arrow(Tuv_vec[0], Tuv_vec[1], GREEN, stroke_width=5)

        label_Tu = MathTex("T(u)", color=ORANGE, font_size=24)
        label_Tu.next_to(scene_pt(Tu_vec[0], Tu_vec[1]), DOWN, buff=0.1)
        label_Tv = MathTex("T(v)", color=ORANGE, font_size=24)
        label_Tv.next_to(scene_pt(Tv_vec[0], Tv_vec[1]), RIGHT, buff=0.1)
        label_Tuv = MathTex("T(u+v)", color=GREEN, font_size=24)
        label_Tuv.next_to(scene_pt(Tuv_vec[0], Tuv_vec[1]), RIGHT, buff=0.1)

        formula_line2 = MathTex(r"T(u+v)=T(u)+T(v)", color=YELLOW, font_size=30)
        self.place_at_grid(formula_line2, "A4", scale_factor=0.9)

        self.play(line2.animate.set_color(YELLOW), run_time=0.5)
        self.play(GrowArrow(vec_u), FadeIn(label_u), run_time=0.8)
        self.play(Create(para1), Create(para2), run_time=1)
        self.play(GrowArrow(vec_uv), FadeIn(label_uv), run_time=0.8)
        self.wait(0.3)
        self.play(GrowArrow(vec_Tu), GrowArrow(vec_Tv),
                  FadeIn(label_Tu), FadeIn(label_Tv), run_time=1)
        self.play(GrowArrow(vec_Tuv), FadeIn(label_Tuv), run_time=0.8)
        self.play(Write(formula_line2), run_time=1)
        self.play(Indicate(formula_line2, color=YELLOW, scale_factor=1.0), run_time=1)
        self.wait(0.3)

        group_line2 = VGroup(vec_u, vec_v, label_u, label_v, vec_uv, label_uv,
                             para1, para2, vec_Tu, vec_Tv, vec_Tuv,
                             label_Tu, label_Tv, label_Tuv)
        self.play(FadeOut(group_line2), FadeOut(formula_line2), run_time=1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        line3 = self.lecture[2]

        vec_v2 = make_arrow(1, 0.6, BLUE)
        label_v2 = MathTex("v", color=BLUE, font_size=28)
        label_v2.next_to(scene_pt(1, 0.6), RIGHT, buff=0.1)

        vec_2v = make_arrow(2, 1.2, BLUE)
        label_2v = MathTex("2v", color=BLUE, font_size=28)
        label_2v.next_to(scene_pt(2, 1.2), RIGHT, buff=0.1)

        Tv_vec2 = np.array([2.0, 0.6, 0])
        T2v_vec2 = np.array([4.0, 1.2, 0])

        vec_Tv2 = make_arrow(Tv_vec2[0], Tv_vec2[1], ORANGE, stroke_width=4)
        label_Tv2 = MathTex("T(v)", color=ORANGE, font_size=24)
        label_Tv2.next_to(scene_pt(Tv_vec2[0], Tv_vec2[1]), RIGHT, buff=0.1)

        vec_T2v = make_arrow(T2v_vec2[0], T2v_vec2[1], ORANGE, stroke_width=4)
        label_T2v = MathTex("T(2v)", color=ORANGE, font_size=24)
        label_T2v.next_to(scene_pt(T2v_vec2[0], T2v_vec2[1]), RIGHT, buff=0.1)

        formula_line3 = MathTex(r"T(cv)=c\,T(v)", color=YELLOW, font_size=32)
        self.place_at_grid(formula_line3, "A4", scale_factor=0.9)

        self.play(line3.animate.set_color(YELLOW), run_time=0.5)
        self.play(GrowArrow(vec_v2), FadeIn(label_v2), run_time=0.8)
        self.play(GrowArrow(vec_2v), FadeIn(label_2v), run_time=0.8)
        self.wait(0.3)
        self.play(GrowArrow(vec_Tv2), FadeIn(label_Tv2), run_time=0.8)
        self.play(GrowArrow(vec_T2v), FadeIn(label_T2v), run_time=0.8)
        self.play(Write(formula_line3), run_time=1)
        self.play(Indicate(formula_line3, color=YELLOW, scale_factor=1.0), run_time=1)
        self.wait(0.3)

        group_line3 = VGroup(vec_v2, label_v2, vec_2v, label_2v,
                             vec_Tv2, label_Tv2, vec_T2v, label_T2v)
        self.play(FadeOut(group_line3), FadeOut(formula_line3), run_time=1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        line4 = self.lecture[3]

        self.play(line4.animate.set_color(YELLOW), run_time=0.5)

        # Build a fresh full grid with more lines, then animate stretch via Transform
        n = 4
        grid_orig = VGroup()
        for i in range(-n, n + 1):
            x_pos = i * 1.0
            grid_orig.add(Line(scene_pt(x_pos, -n), scene_pt(x_pos, n),
                               color=GRAY, stroke_width=1.5))
            y_pos = i * 1.0
            grid_orig.add(Line(scene_pt(-n, y_pos), scene_pt(n, y_pos),
                               color=GRAY, stroke_width=1.5))

        # Transformed grid: x -> 2x
        grid_stretched = VGroup()
        for i in range(-n, n + 1):
            x_pos = i * 2.0
            grid_stretched.add(Line(scene_pt(x_pos, -n), scene_pt(x_pos, n),
                                    color=GRAY, stroke_width=1.5))
            y_pos = i * 1.0
            grid_stretched.add(Line(scene_pt(-2 * n, y_pos), scene_pt(2 * n, y_pos),
                                    color=GRAY, stroke_width=1.5))

        self.play(Create(grid_orig), run_time=1.5)
        self.wait(0.3)
        self.play(Transform(grid_orig, grid_stretched), run_time=2)
        self.wait(0.3)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        line5 = self.lecture[4]

        label_Tgrid = Text("T(grid)", color=CYAN, font_size=26)
        self.place_at_grid(label_Tgrid, "F2", scale_factor=0.8)

        vec_v3 = make_arrow(1, 0, BLUE, stroke_width=5)
        label_v3 = MathTex("v=(1,0)", color=BLUE, font_size=24)
        label_v3.next_to(scene_pt(1, 0), UP, buff=0.15)

        vec_Tv3 = make_arrow(2, 0, ORANGE, stroke_width=5)
        label_Tv3 = MathTex("T(v)=(2,0)", color=ORANGE, font_size=24)
        label_Tv3.next_to(scene_pt(2, 0), DOWN, buff=0.15)

        formula_line5 = MathTex(r"T(x,y)=(2x,\,y)", color=YELLOW, font_size=30)
        self.place_at_grid(formula_line5, "A4", scale_factor=0.9)

        self.play(line5.animate.set_color(YELLOW), run_time=0.5)
        self.play(FadeIn(label_Tgrid), run_time=0.6)
        self.play(GrowArrow(vec_v3), FadeIn(label_v3), run_time=0.8)
        self.play(GrowArrow(vec_Tv3), FadeIn(label_Tv3), run_time=0.8)
        self.play(Write(formula_line5), run_time=1)
        self.play(Indicate(formula_line5, color=YELLOW, scale_factor=1.0),
                  Indicate(vec_Tv3, color=ORANGE, scale_factor=1.0), run_time=1.2)
        self.wait(1)
